title: Nabhold InventoryOwnershipRecord domain identifiers, enumerations and resource
description: Gate ZB-01 initial publication (ADR-SHARED-008 SS5): which legal entity owns a quantity of stock at a location, distinct from physical custody. Governed under the capability/v1 namespace registry's `inventory` domain. Exists primarily to support ADR-BCP-012's intercompany in-transit-ownership model.

inventoryOwnershipId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for an InventoryOwnershipRecord.

inventoryOwnershipType.description: Nature of the owning legal entity's claim over the stock quantity.

location_reference.description: Opaque reference to the physical or virtual location holding the stock. This package does not mint a canonical Location/Warehouse ID.
